strcon.name: Strategy Stretch Preferred (Ondo Tokenized)

facts.value: STRCon is a structured-note economic exposure to STRC. Tokenholders can redeem for then-value subject to eligibility/terms; they do not obtain underlying shareholder voting or information rights, nor a right to receive STRC shares.
Swiss law governs tokenholder rights and obligations under issuer Sales Terms; issuer domicile is BVI.
Primary purchases and redemptions require KYC onboarding; US persons, US-originating orders and prohibited jurisdictions are excluded, with further local investor restrictions.
Docs describe redemption into USDon or USDC; instant USDC conversion depends on stablecoin-swapper liquidity and permissioning. USD bank-wire redemption is not supported in this documentation.
Issuer describes segregated SPV assets and a first-priority collateral security interest held by Ankura, with liquidation/distribution powers on specified default events.
Docs distinguish daily holdings verification by Ankura, monthly reconciliations, annual financial audits, and separate smart-contract audits. No individual report is verified by this row.
Issuer SPV has a board with an independent director and separate books/accounts; tokenization/general administration is provided by Ondo Finance.
